name: Google Cloud MCP servers
description: Connects MCP clients to Google-managed remote MCP servers for BigQuery, GKE, Compute Engine, Cloud Run, Cloud SQL, Maps, and more, with IAM controls, toolsets, and Model Armor.

skills.name: Toolsets
skills.description: Selects a logical group of MCP tools, each with its own endpoint, so agents load only the tools they need.

skills.name: IAM Access Control
skills.description: Controls who can use which MCP tools on which Google Cloud resources with IAM allow and deny policies.

skills.name: Model Armor Protection
skills.description: Scans MCP requests and responses to mitigate prompt injection, sensitive data disclosure, and tool poisoning.

skills.name: MCP Apps
skills.description: Renders sandboxed charts, forms, and dashboards from supported servers inside the agent conversation.
